cohort: 51 women with deep endometriosis who underwent bowel resection surgery
finding: Women who underwent bowel resection for deep endometriosis had an increased risk of gestational hypertension, placenta previa, and lower newborn weight compared to controls.
mod_finding: While women with previous bowel resection had a higher rate of caesarean section, there was no difference in complication rates between vaginal and caesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Average newborn weight was 3000 +/- 545 g in the bowel resection group.
